task.title: P6-001: Fix two pre-existing table overflows outside frame widths (re-measure first)
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 7 — UX, a11y and visual, Visual and layout). Original id: P6-001. Size: M. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-design.md.

**Two pre-existing table overflows outside the nine frames' widths** — **below ~385 px** (9–14 px of sideways scroll at 375, 64–69 px at 320) and **30–34 px at exactly 768 px**, where `md` adds the Type column back before the extra width is available (`collection.rs:1195`, `all_cards.rs:352` — `hidden md:table-cell`, consistent with the claimed mechanism). Neither belongs to the responsive audit: measured by reverting its classes in the live DOM, that branch *reduces* the tables' intrinsic width by ~20 px at every width below `md` and resolves to exactly the pre-task values at ≥768. 375 px is a real device width (iPhone SE/mini), so the first one matters more than its absence from the frames suggests. **Re-measure before fixing** — the pixel numbers are from the original audit and the code has moved since; the check is loading the table at 320/375/768 and comparing `scrollWidth` to `clientWidth`.
